news.headline: JPMorgan Reinstates Coverage on Nektar with Neutral Rating, $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan resumed coverage of Nektar with a Neutral/Hold rating and a $65 price target, implying downside from the then-current price even as the Street's broader consensus stayed bullish on rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Slides as Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 4% on the Q2 earnings reaction as investors weighed Nektar's continued heavy cash burn (Q2 net loss of $40.6M on $10.1M revenue) against progress launching the global Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported $1.02 billion in cash and investments as of June 30, 2026 and raised its year-end cash guidance to $815-840 million, extending its runway into Q3 2028; management reaffirmed plans for a Q4 2026 alopecia areata off-treatment data readout and a Q1 2027 atopic dermatitis off-treatment readout.

news.headline: Pretrial Conference Held in Nektar v. Eli Lilly Ahead of September 8 Jury Trial
news.source: U.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. docket (3:23-cv-03943) / Law360
news.summary: A pretrial conference took place before Judge James Donato ahead of the scheduled September 8, 2026 jury trial in Nektar's breach-of-contract suit against Eli Lilly over alleged mishandling of rezpeg trial data; Lilly's motion for summary judgment had previously been denied in March 2026.

news.headline: Canaccord Genuity Initiates Coverage of Nektar with Buy Rating, $153 Price Target
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash started coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and $153 price target, citing the rezpegaldesleukin opportunity in atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials (targeting ~1,530 patients total) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with initial topline data expected mid-2028 and a BLA targeted for 2029.

catalysts.label: Jury trial opens: Nektar v. Eli Lilly
catalysts.detail: Breach-of-contract jury trial in the Northern District of California over Lilly's handling/reporting of rezpeg's earlier eczema and psoriasis trial data; Lilly's summary judgment motion was denied in March 2026. Outcome could affect prior collaboration economics and reputational overhang, though it is not expected to affect current rezpeg IP/development rights.

catalysts.label: Start of ZENITH AD-3 trial
catalysts.detail: Third Phase 3 ZENITH AD trial, enrolling biologic/JAK-inhibitor treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients, expected to begin dosing by the end of September per company guidance on the Q2 2026 call.

catalysts.label: EADV Congress oral presentation
catalysts.detail: Nektar will present 52-week Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA data (severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata) in session FC04.1D at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology Congress in Hall N.

catalysts.label: 24-week off-treatment data (alopecia areata)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance for presentation of 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b study, assessing durability of rezpeg's effect after stopping dosing.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to begin a single registrational Phase 3 trial in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, designed following FDA End-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice.

catalysts.label: 52-week off-treatment data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance for 52-week off-treatment durability data from the REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b study in atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline readouts from the Phase 3 ZENITH AD atopic dermatitis registrational program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin.

pulse: Nektar is executing its post-turnaround plan: it started dosing in the global Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in July, plans a third ZENITH AD trial by end of September, and holds over $1 billion in cash (guided to $815-840M by year-end) giving runway into Q3 2028 past the first Phase 3 readouts. The near-term overhang is the Nektar v. Eli Lilly breach-of-contract jury trial, which per the court docket is set to open September 8, 2026 after Lilly's bid for summary judgment was denied; a win, loss, or settlement there is a binary event investors are watching alongside upcoming REZOLVE-AA/AD durability data (Q4 2026 and Q1 2027) and an EADV data presentation on October 1. Wall Street sentiment is mixed-to-bullish on valuation (Canaccord Buy $153, other targets well above the stock price) but JPMorgan's reinstated Neutral rating and post-earnings share weakness reflect lingering concern over continued heavy cash burn ahead of 2028-2029 pivotal data and BLA milestones.
